title: Orthophoto
lede: An up-to-date, georeferenced orthophoto of the site, ready to use.
intro: An orthophoto is an aerial image that has been geometrically corrected so it can be measured and placed on a map. It is used for planning, recording existing conditions and comparing a site over time.

Flight and processing are tailored to the size of the site and the output you need. Resolution, accuracy and scale figures are not listed here — they will be set for each project and included in a proposal.
uses: A base map for planning and survey

side.title: Talk about a site
side.text: Send a site boundary and the kind of map you need, and we will get back to you.
